cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

mechanism: Copy badge removal as relinquishing office, then seek a decisive commitment after learning the two offices cannot be exchanged.
confusable: Not an informed power challenge: B2 must reveal a pin repair and B4 the different teams, with A masking both mistakes.
comparison: Organizing two teams' fixtures rather than cooking for a housemate.
seedUse: Retains captaincy rematch and meaningful wager; creates misunderstood badge repair and substitutes workload for incompatible offices.
